body: Supersedes 2.1.0, which is kept tagged (AGENTS.md: never re-cut). One fix, T-231: the cuneiform on the web login and About pages did not render — the SPA fallback swallowed the separately fetched svg, and Firefox refused the mask — so the sign is inlined and the server now serves any root-level bundle file. Patch version: a defect in 2.1.0 with no new behaviour; the APK is rebuilt by release.sh as always but nothing in it changed.
title: Release 2.1.1
